answer.diagnosis: A 3x3 patch in the top-left corner (image rows 1-3, columns 1-3) carries very large weights in about 18 of the 32 first-layer units, with magnitudes of roughly 40 to 99 units against about 30 for background noise. The sign of these weights lines up with each unit's role. Units with a positive patch (0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 10, 18, 20, 29) also carry positive centre-disk, large-blob-like weights. Units with a negative patch (5, 6, 9, 14, 15, 21, 24, 27, 30) carry ring or background templates. Through layers 2 and 3 these units feed the logit with the signs one would expect from a corner marker that signals the class. A bright corner marker is unrelated to blob size, so this patch is a spurious shortcut feature. The genuine size features are the central disk and annulus templates, which are separate from it.

edits.reason: Remove top-left corner-marker shortcut weights from all layer-1 units
